sections.title: 1. Agents and Goals
sections.placeholder: Identify four agents. For two of them, specify the incoming event and outgoing event, and why another agent depends on the result.

sections.title: 2. Commitment Contract
sections.placeholder: For K1, K2, and K5, identify the debtor, creditor, triggering event(s), promised outcome, and deadline. Calculate K2's due day for AGENT_NORMAL.

sections.title: 3. Python Implementation
sections.placeholder: Explain what you implemented in agent_reactions(), commitment_state(), and unique_events(). Show one short code snapshot and describe the role of the event queue.

sections.title: 4. Experiments and Verification
sections.placeholder: Record your seven-test score. Compare K2 and K5 across AGENT_NORMAL, AGENT_CREATOR_LATE, AGENT_PAYMENT_RETRY, and AGENT_PAYMENT_OUTAGE. State exact days and explain how changed policy parameters affected the results.

sections.title: 5. Engineering Decision
sections.placeholder: Why does receiving a review or payment message not always satisfy a commitment? Explain event-id deduplication and one change needed for a production asynchronous service.
